answer: Because the onyx collateral is checked against the quartz claim at intake, the jade audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases hence has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Posted collateral must equal 8 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
